purpose: Story-complexity typed prompts for Studio Generate human animation-quality judgment (P020). Not held-out harness regression; not a corpus commission.

tasks.title: City loop
tasks.prompt: Create a looping city street animation: mustard car, walkers, a cyclist, and café shopfronts. The camera eases along the block and the loop should feel seamless when it repeats. Favour readable motion and atmosphere over tiny diagrams.

tasks.title: Blueprint → home
tasks.prompt: Animate a house assembling from blueprint linework into a warm finished home. Reveal rooms as walls rise; keep the camera purposeful so the build reads as a story, not a HUD.

tasks.title: Crane fold
tasks.prompt: Show a paper square folding into a crane, hovering, then unfolding back to a square. Make crease timing and silhouette readable—even if the paper stays firmly 2D.

tasks.title: Pixels → prediction
tasks.prompt: Start from chunky pixels and resolve into a clearer predictive figure or chart. The transformation should feel intentional and watchable, not a single static slide.

tasks.title: Copperleaf run
tasks.prompt: A small character runs and jumps across platforms, collecting coins, then enters a cavern. Keep poses, jumps, and camera framing legible as a short adventure beat.

tasks.title: Streetlight
tasks.prompt: A noir streetlight scene: silhouetted figure under a warm lamp, soft smoke, and a camera that cranes or tilts with mood. Prioritise lighting and composition over UI chrome.

tasks.title: Small ideas
tasks.prompt: Many tiny geometric ideas appear, combine, and grow into one larger transforming composition. Emphasise choreography and visual payoff, not a bullet list of shapes.
